data.name: Unicap Modaraba
data.description: Unicap Modaraba is a multipurpose, perpetual modaraba floated in Pakistan in the year 1991 under Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation & Control) Ordinance, 1980. Al-Zamin Modaraba Management (Private) Limited transferred the management of Modaraba to Map Out Modaraba Company (Private) Limited.
